items.q: When Bob Rolontz got this label, I took Jack Dupree over there.

trouble was, when we did this date with Mickey Baker and all those people -- the first time I did this date, everybody wanted to know who was the star. Because I had been doing recording dates. You know, I was writing for -- See, I was writing for a lot of dates, you know. And so when I went down to do -- When Bob Rolontz got this label, I took Jack Dupree over there.
